headlines.title: Political donations in France swerve to the right as Le Pen’s niece raises more than Macron
Battered by Far Right in E.U. Vote, Macron Calls for New Elections in France
headlines.abstract: The president’s decision, on the eve of the summer Olympic Games that begin in Paris in July, ushered in a period of deep political uncertainty in France.

headlines.title: In Calling Elections in France, Macron Makes a Huge Gamble
headlines.abstract: The president has challenged voters to test the sincerity of their support for the far right in European elections. Were the French letting off steam, or did they really mean it?

headlines.title: Tuesday briefing: Has Macron set France on course for a far-right government?
Macron’s Call for Elections in France Adds to Fears of Financial Woes
headlines.abstract: Moody’s ratings agency warned of a downgrade on French debt, saying the move could worsen France’s finances by creating “a polarized political environment.”
